data.name: American Horror Story
data.overview: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.

seasons.name: Murder House
seasons.overview: When the Harmon family relocates to a stately mansion in Los Angeles, disturbing secrets start enveloping each of their lives. As they slowly learn about the mysterious and deadly history of their new house, psychiatrist Ben, Vivien and their teenage daughter Violet find themselves surrounded by all manner of menacing spirits, living and dead.

seasons.name: Asylum
seasons.overview: From Nazis and serial killers to mutants and aliens, no one is safe inside the walls of the Briarcliff Mental Institution. In a house of healing that is anything but, troubled nun Sister Jude rules with an iron fist and Dr Arden conducts strange experiments on the facility's patients.

seasons.name: Coven
seasons.overview: The few remaining Salem descendants are under assault by forces of ignorance and hate. The young witches seek refuge at Miss Robichaux's Academy in New Orleans, including new arrival, Zoe, who harbors a terrifying secret of her own. Fiona, a Supreme Witch with unimaginable powers, is determined to protect the Coven, but her obsessive quest for immortality will lead her to cross paths with a voodoo queen and a murderous slave owner cursed with eternal life.

seasons.name: Freak Show
seasons.overview: In 1952, in the quiet, sleepy hamlet of Jupiter, Florida, a troupe of human "curiosities" has just arrived in town, coinciding with the strange emergence of a dark entity that savagely threatens the lives of townsfolk and freaks alike.

seasons.name: Hotel
seasons.overview: Homicide detective John Lowe traces a series of grisly murders back to the stylish Hotel Cortez in Downtown Los Angeles and its infamous residents.

seasons.name: Roanoke
seasons.overview: After a disturbing incident, a young couple move into a seemingly perfect home built in the 18th century. However, the building's proximity to the site of the Lost Colony's disappearance and with horrific events happening at the house the couple start to sense something dark underneath the façade.

seasons.name: Cult
seasons.overview: Set just after the 2016 U.S. presidential election, the seventh installment follows a community torn apart by a dangerous cult leader who uses fear as a weapon.

seasons.name: Apocalypse
seasons.overview: After the nuclear apocalypse, the world's chosen elite survive in secure Outposts created by the mysterious Cooperative. On the American West Coast, Ms. Wilhemina Venable and Ms. Miriam Mead run Outpost Three with an iron fist. The unexpected arrival of Michael Langdon, a Cooperative representative determined to save society with a secret paradise, throws their order into chaos. However, underneath the surface of humanity's salvation lies a battlefield for the final conflict between good and evil.

In the summer of 1984, five friends escape Los Angeles to work as counselors at Camp Redwood. As they adjust to their new jobs, they quickly learn that the only thing scarier than campfire tales is the past coming to haunt them.

seasons.name: Double Feature
seasons.overview: A struggling writer, his pregnant wife, and their daughter move to an isolated beach town for the winter. Once they're settled in, the town’s true residents begin to make themselves known.

seasons.name: NYC
seasons.overview: Mysterious deaths and disappearances ramp up in the city. Meanwhile, a doctor makes a frightening discovery, and a local reporter becomes tomorrow’s headline.

seasons.name: Delicate
seasons.overview: After multiple failed attempts of IVF, actress Anna Victoria Alcott wants nothing more than to start a family. As the buzz around her recent film grows, she fears that something may be targeting her and her pursuit of motherhood.
Follows Ben DeSoto, a hospice caretaker suffering from triskaidekaphobia, who takes a strange job at The Apollyon, an eerie residential building inhabited by characters from seasons past.

data.overview: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.

Die Serienanthologie American Horror Story erzählt von Staffel zu Staffel verschiedene, in sich abgeschlossene Geschichten, die sich mit unterschiedlichen Arten von Horror beschäftigen. Während jedes Jahr die Thematik sowie das Setting und viele Darsteller gewechselt werden, kehren einige Schauspieler mehrmals in unterschiedlichen Rollen zur Serie zurück.

American Horror Story es una serie antológica de televisión, creada y producida por Ryan Murphy y Brad Falchuk. Cada una de sus temporadas narra una trama independiente, ambientada en lugares diferentes y cerrando siempre la historia; donde muchos actores repiten, pero siempre interpretando personajes distintos.

É uma série de televisão norte-americana de terror-drama. Descrita como uma série antológica, cada temporada é concebida como uma mini-série independente, seguindo um conjunto de personagens e ambientes distintos e com enredo único por temporada.

data.name: Зловеща семейна история
data.overview: През лятото на 1984 г. петима приятели избягат от Лос Анджелис, за да работят като съветници в лагер Редууд. Докато се приспособяват към новите си работни места, те бързо научават, че единственото по-страшно от приказките около лагерния огън е миналото, което идва да ви преследва.

data.name: American Horror Story
data.overview: American Horror Story is een Amerikaanse drama/horror serie bedacht door Ryan Murphy en Brad Falchuk. Ieder seizoen heeft een volledig op zichzelf staand verhaal met nieuwe personages. Dit betreft een bezeten huis (Murder House), een gekkenhuis (Asylum), een groep heksen (Coven), een tentoonstelling met aparte verschijnselen (Freak Show), een mysterieus hotel (Hotel), een boerderij waar gruwelijke dingen plaatsvinden (Roanoke), een sekte (Cult) en het einde der tijden (Apocalypse). Een aantal van de hoofdrolspelers duikt desondanks toch in meerdere seizoenen op, telkens in een andere rol.

data.name: Американская история ужасов
data.overview: В разных уголках Америки разворачиваются мрачные и пугающие истории, где обычная жизнь сталкивается с необъяснимыми явлениями, тайнами прошлого и сверхъестественными силами. Каждый сезон переносит зрителей в новое место и новую эпоху — от проклятого дома и закрытой психиатрической лечебницы до таинственного отеля, шабаша ведьм и изолированной общины. Героям предстоит столкнуться со своими страхами, чужими секретами и ужасами, которые постепенно выходят за пределы человеческого понимания.

À chaque saison, son histoire. American Horror Story nous embarque dans des récits à la fois poignants et cauchemardesques, mêlant la peur, le gore et le politiquement correct. De quoi vous confronter à vos plus grandes frayeurs !

data.name: American Horror Story
data.overview: American Horror Story è una serie antologica prodotta da FX. Ogni stagione racconta una storia autoconclusiva legata al genere horror, esplorando argomenti e sottogeneri come lo slasher, la casa infestata dagli spettri, la stregoneria, il satanismo, il manicomio e persino l’elezione presidenziale del 2016. Il cast rimane parzialmente invariato ogni anno, dando agli attori la possibilità di interpretare più ruoli. Anche se ogni ciclo di episodi è tecnicamente a sé stante, personaggi di una stagione specifica possono apparire in un’altra, dato che tutte le storie si svolgono nel medesimo universo. In particolare, l’ottava stagione è un vero e proprio crossover tra la prima e la terza.

data.name: 美国恐怖故事
data.overview: 从闹鬼的豪宅到精神病院，从女巫、马戏团到酒店、邪教、末日与外星人，每一季都讲述一个全新的恐怖故事。它不只是制造鬼魂、杀人狂与怪物，更将恐惧藏进家庭、欲望、宗教、政治、疾病与人性之中。看似彼此独立的故事，又通过人物、地点与事件悄然连接，最终构成一个庞大的“美国恐怖宇宙”。

Τηλεοπτική σειρά τρόμου παραγωγής Ράιαν Μέρφι και Μπραντ Φάλτσακ. Αποτελείται από διαφορετικές σεζόν, κάθε μία εκ των οποίων περιγράφει ξεχωριστές ιστορίες με νέους χαρακτήρες και διαφορετικά γεγονότα.
Η πρώτη σεζόν λαμβάνει χώρα στο Λος Άντζελες και ακολουθεί τη ζωή μίας οικογένειας που μετακομίζει σε ένα σπίτι που το στοιχειώνουν οι πρώην ιδιοκτήτες του. Τα γεγονότα της δεύτερης σεζόν διαδραματίζονται στη Μασαχουσέτη του 1964 και συγκεκριμένα σε ένα άσυλο για ψυχασθενείς εγκληματίες, όπου και εξελίσσονται οι ιστορίες τους. Κατά την τρίτη σεζόν παρακολουθούμε τις διαμάχες μεταξύ μαγισσών και ατόμων που εξασκούν βουντού. Τα γεγονότα λαμβάνουν χώρα στη Νέα Ορλεάνη το 2013, αλλά γίνονται αναφορές και σε αρκετά γεγονότα του 1800. Η τέταρτη σεζόν σχετίζεται με τα γεγονότα που γίνονται σε ένα τσίρκο, στη Φλόριντα του 1952. Η πέμπτη σεζόν λαμβάνει χώρα σε ένα στοιχειωμένο ξενοδοχείο στο Λος Άντζελες του 2015.
